inputs.text: Vertical over-desk medium close shot of Lin Xiaoyu comparing a travel photograph source on a laptop with a phone. Both displays are angled away or softly blurred, containing no readable generated text. Her expression shifts from confusion to betrayal. Premium handcrafted 3D plush doll, cold investigative light, warm lamp nearly gone, physically natural hands, no visible UI, no text. Animate only the following controlled action. Start: the frame contains exactly one phone with its matte back facing camera and one laptop whose display faces only Lin Xiaoyu. Action: both devices and both hands remain completely fixed; only her eyes move once from the phone toward the laptop and her lips part slightly in realization. End: the frame still contains exactly the same one phone and one laptop. No object is raised or created. Motion is extremely small. Preserve the exact first-frame composition, character identity, outfit, props, and room. The camera stays locked and stable. Only subtle lip and eye movement. Never create a second phone, never reveal a screen, and never display any picture or interface.
